skin_friction.traction: tangent-flow speed squared, projected on each wetted triangle
skin_friction.limitations: Attached-flow estimate; no resolved boundary layer, separation, viscous form factor or plume.

method.interpolation: Direct native quintic RBF with compact native residual refinement, compiled to a runtime trilinear tensor.
method.numerical_acceptance: Historical policies retained per source; all saved states rechecked with the current native Euler operator.
method.scope: Native CFD and independent database error only; no spatial or equipment-specific physical-accuracy claim.

training_check.scope: Fresh independent native samples of the frozen runtime trilinear interpolant; not a continuous CFD or physical error bound.

development.reference_scope: Original complete expanded native CFD envelope, fixed before the replacement validation.
development.scope: Unsolved tensor nodes are interpolation estimates. The failed old test set is development, and this replacement requires a new untouched native test design.

sampling_validation.scope: Fresh independent native samples of the frozen runtime trilinear interpolant; not a continuous CFD or physical error bound.

qualification.scope: Individually retained native CFD, current terminal-state audits and fresh independent interpolation checks; no spatial or equipment-accuracy claim.
